_meanings:
.²1 Impurity, dirtiness, foulness; <ls>Pt. 1. 195</ls>.
.²2 Legal impurity or contamination; defilement caused either by child-birth
 (called {#jananASOca#}) or by the death of some relation (called {#mftASOca#});
 it lasts for 10 days; during the {#mftASOca#} a person defiled by it is
 not to touch anybody else, or to eat with others in the same row or to
 do any sacred action; {#ahorAtramupAsIrannaSOcaM bAnDavEH saha#} <ls>Ms. 11. 183</ls>.
blending or coming together of two or more defilements.
